## Writing

### Introducing BDK Swift Example Wallet

URL: https://www.matthewramsden.com/posts/2024/10-14.html

Published: October 14, 2024

The post introduces BDK Swift Example Wallet, an iOS example app built around Bitcoin Dev Kit 1.0 and the Swift bindings from bdk-ffi. It explains design and implementation choices for a native iOS bitcoin wallet experience.

Key topics:

- Audience: bitcoiners testing Signet, Testnet, or Mutinynet wallets; developers exploring BDK 1.0; developers who want a starting point for their own bitcoin app.
- Native iOS design: built-in platform controls, light and dark mode, Dynamic Type, gestures, animations, and native interaction patterns.
- Onboarding: one-screen onboarding with create-or-import actions, a default network, and minimal setup friction.
- Wallet balance display: a custom bitcoin and sats formatting approach designed for readability.
- Send and receive actions: icon-focused mobile affordances for showing QR codes and scanning QR codes.
- Sync: visual treatment inspired by BDK 1.0 sync capabilities and inspected script pubkeys.
- Address display: bitcoin address formatting informed by the Bitcoin Design Guide.
- Seed display: visual treatment informed by the Bitcoin Design daily spending wallet guidance.
- Download: links to the GitHub repository and TestFlight build.

Related links from the post:

- Bitcoin Dev Kit: https://bitcoindevkit.org
- bdk-ffi: https://github.com/bitcoindevkit/bdk-ffi
- BDK Swift Example Wallet: https://github.com/bitcoindevkit/BDKSwiftExampleWallet
- Bitcoin Design Guide: https://bitcoin.design/guide/
- TestFlight: https://testflight.apple.com/join/mz0UxYhT
